snippet.title: Gently Packed Demo Announcement
snippet.description: Step into the shoes of a cashier in Gently Packed, a relaxing store management game where you scan, pack, and serve customers with care. Upgrade your shop, run promotions, meet corporate goals, and pay off your franchise loan.
